difficulty_reason: Builds the closed subscheme X gluing U' on S setminus Z with W formally along Z: the algebraic assembly picks the radical ideal J cutting out X via the More on Algebra equivalence of ideal data, computes J'' = Ker(A -> A') from the proper cover X', identifies J_i = J''[1/f_i] by flat base change, and proves the equality of J' with J''A^ up to I-powers by the rig-etale/rig-surjective permanence chain and the closed-immersion rig-smooth lemma, giving the finite-n inclusion I^n J''A^ ⊂ J'.
